Subject: Acme POC: Integration & Evaluation Plan

Hi Jordan / Priya

Great to meet you both on the call today. Per our discussion, I put together a short follow-up with proposed success criteria, ownership, timeline, and an initial integration plan so your engineers have something concrete to review. Attached: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (POC plan), integration-snippets.zip (SDK + curl examples), acme-eval-criteria.xlsx (suggested metrics).

Summary / Success criteria (proposed)
- Functional: Redwood inference integrated into Acme's support pipeline and answering user intents with >=80% intent-detection accuracy on your test set.
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 400ms for short queries (<=256 tokens) under target load of 20 rps.
- Cost: token unit cost within the budget range we discussed (we'll finalize after initial run).
- Reliability: end-to-end test pass rate >= 99% over 48h run.

Evaluation plan and ownership
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + access exchange (ACME to provide staging API keys, sample dataset). Owner: Jordan (ACME) + Marissa (Redwood).
- Week 1: Integration + basic smoke tests. Owner: Neha (Redwood SE) + ACME eng.
- Week 2: Load testing and quality evals against acme-eval-criteria.xlsx. Owner: Marcus (Redwood CS) + ACME eng.
- Week 3: Review & decision meeting (go/no-go). Decision owners: Jordan (ACME) + Redwood PM.

Integration plan (high level)
- Auth: Use per-environment API keys; Redwood will provide staging keys for the trial.
- SDKs: We recommend starting with our Python SDK for quick iteration (examples in integration-snippets.zip).
- API routes: POST /v1/generate for text generation; POST /v1/stream for streaming responses (we'll send chunked responses for lower latency UI).
- Streaming & tool calling: If you plan to use tool-calling or external tools, we'll enable function-calling on the model and provide webhook examples. Streaming can be turned on by setting stream=true in the request.
- KV/prefix caching: If you have repeated prefixes (e.g., system instructions), we'll show how to enable prefix caching to lower cost.

Immediate next steps
1) Jordan: share staging domain and sample dataset (preferably 500-1,000 representative queries).
2) Jordan/Priya: confirm target KPI thresholds above or propose adjustments.
3) Redwood (Neha): schedule an integration session with your eng team next week; we'll bring a troubleshooting checklist.

Suggested meeting: Mon, Jun 29 10:00 AM PT
- 30m integration walkthrough. Does that work?

Thanks
- looking forward to getting this going.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan / team

Thanks
- quick technical notes ahead of tomorrow's walkthrough so your engineers have context:

1) Streaming: Our Python and JS SDKs include SSE-based streaming examples. The integration-snippets.zip includes a React example using EventSource and a Node example using fetch + ReadableStream for server push. If you prefer SSE exclusively, the SDK can be configured to emit SSE frames; set stream=true and transport="sse" in the client.

2) API routes and example payloads (short):
- POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  Body: {"model":"rwd-medium-1","input":"<user text>","max_tokens":256} (non-streaming)
- POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true
  Body: same as above (streaming chunks).
- POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/functions/call
  Body: {"function":"lookup_customer","params":{...}} (function/tool calling flow example included)

3) Auth: We'll provide a staging API key scope-limited to the POC account. For private deployments we support KMS-backed key rotation; for the POC API keys are standard Bearer tokens.

4) Observability: For the trial we'll enable 7-day request logs and token-level breakdowns in the console. Marcus will run the quality eval scripts from acme-eval-criteria.xlsx and share the results.

5) Samples we'll need from you before the walkthrough:
- 500 sample queries (CSV)
- Representative schema for tool-calls (if you plan to use backend lookups)
- Any UI constraints (e.g., max latency tolerated for live typing)

If helpful I pasted a quick curl example below: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <STAGING_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-1","input":"Summarize support ticket #12345","max_tokens":120}'

Look forward to the walkthrough tomorrow. I'll bring the live integration checklist and some troubleshooting tips.







- Neha Kapoor
